verdict.passRate: ZERO delta. Both arms passed every assertion. Per the evaluation contract a zero delta has two causes the numbers cannot separate — the skill is redundant, or the cases were too easy. This run points at a third, and both cases carry it: the case set is defective. Case 1 is contaminated (the fixture names the tool the without-arm was supposed to lack); case 2's assertions are too weak to see a difference the arms plainly showed (with-arm declined and wrote nothing, without-arm did not decline and wrote a file). Neither zero is evidence about the skill.
verdict.cost: The without-arm cost MORE: 7,065 extra tokens (+7.2%) and 100 seconds more wall clock (2.6x). Directionally the skill made the work cheaper and faster even where the outcome matched — but with 2 cases, one contaminated, and two structurally different arms in case 2 (the with-arm declined immediately, so it barely ran), this is a hint to test properly, not a result.
